info.title: Merchant API
info.description: The Prahsys Merchant API provides a comprehensive suite of endpoints for managing merchants, processing payments, and accessing transaction data. This RESTful API supports multi-tenant architecture with organization-based access control and separate Live/Sandbox environments for testing.

BearerAuth.description: API Key authentication using Bearer token scheme. Include your API key in the Authorization header with the format: `Authorization: Bearer {your_api_key}`. You can obtain your API key from your Prahsys Dashboard under Developer > API Keys. Ensure you keep your API key secure and never expose it in client-side code or public repositories. API keys have different permissions based on your organization role and can be scoped to specific environments (Live/Sandbox).
